page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c5.2xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8163 processor on the KVM hypervisor. The instance provides 8 dedicated vCPUs across 4 physical cores with multithreading enabled. System memory is configured at 16.0 GB, establishing a 1:2 core-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. The CPU architecture includes 35 MB of L3 cache alongside hardware support for vector processing and cryptography instructions, including AVX, AVX-512F, AVX-512 VNNI, and AES. Network baseline throughput is rated at 2 Gbps, and no local disk storage or GPU acceleration is included, requiring all storage persistence to be provisioned via external network-attached volumes.

Benchmark results place the processing and memory subsystems of this instance primarily in the middle-to-lower performance tiers compared against broader server cohorts. PassMark evaluations record an overall CPU score of 6992.04 and an extended instructions score of 6075.96. In Geekbench testing, the instance records 989.0 for single-core and 3785.0 for multi-core performance. Memory throughput remains steady under large block operations, sustaining 40.27 GB/sec for uncached reads and 35.09 GB/sec for writes. Conversely, stress-ng results (1103.39 single-core and 5887.86 multi-core) and single-threaded gzip compression (19.07 GB/sec) highlight constrained throughput on legacy core pipelines.

From a cost-efficiency and architecture standpoint, the instance offers dedicated compute resources for tasks that do not demand extensive RAM capacity or ultra-fast localized NVMe storage. Workload fit includes software build pipelines—corroborated by a Clang compilation score of 5607.0—alongside batch processing, stateless microservices, and general-purpose compute jobs that benefit from predictable vCPU allocation without high I/O or memory overhead.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c5.2xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance featuring 8 vCPUs across 4 physical cores on a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8163 processor, paired with 16.0 GB of memory and a 2 Gbps baseline network interface. Based on the KVM hypervisor, this x86_64 instance provides hardware support for AVX-512 and AVX-512 VNNI instruction sets. It lacks integrated local storage and GPU acceleration, necessitating external volumes for persistent file systems. Performance testing yields a PassMark CPU score of 6992.04 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 3785.0, with steady uncached memory read bandwidth of 40.27 GB/sec. Across synthetic benchmarks, its legacy core architecture shows modest compute density relative to newer generational alternatives. The ecs.c5.2xlarge is suited for light-to-moderate batch processing, continuous integration compilation tasks, and non-memory-heavy application tiers that benefit from dedicated Intel x86 virtual processing cores without extreme I/O requirements.
